"Paste a prompt from the persona marketplace, save it, then add it to AstrBot."
"Check for compatible AstrBot updates at most once a day when the app is open and a network is available. After a failed or interrupted check, wait at least one hour before retrying."

"vivo / iQOO: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management. Find this app and allow high background power consumption. In iManager → App management → Permissions → Auto-start, allow this app. Some versions use Apps and permissions instead."
"Xiaomi / Redmi: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → this app. Enable Auto-start and set Battery saver to No restrictions. HyperOS may place the option under Background auto-start."

"Huawei / HONOR: Settings → Apps → App launch. Disable automatic management for this app and manually allow auto-launch, secondary launch and running in the background. Also allow background operation in battery settings."
"OPPO / realme / OnePlus: Settings → Apps → App management → this app. Allow auto-launch, secondary launch and background activity. Select Unrestricted in battery management."
"Samsung: Settings → Apps → this app → Battery → Unrestricted. In Device care → Battery → Background usage limits, add this app to Never sleeping apps."
"Settings → Apps → this app → Battery. Choose Unrestricted or Allow background activity. Also allow this app in any auto-start, background battery or app launch management settings."

"1. Open notification settings for this app and allow notifications.\n2. Keep the Local services channel enabled. Some devices combine channel settings with app notification settings.\n3. Once services start, check the notification shade to view status or stop them."

"1. Use the button below to request exemption from system battery optimization.\n2. Choose Allow in the system dialog. If already exempt, the optimization list opens; select All apps if needed.\n3. This page refreshes when you return. Manufacturer battery limits must be configured separately."

"1. Open manufacturer background battery management and find this app.\n2. Allow high background power consumption, choose Unrestricted, or allow background activity.\n3. You can also open this app\'s battery settings to check individual restrictions."

"Allowing auto-start and secondary launch helps the system restore the app in the background. This permission does not enable starting services at boot. After restarting the phone, unlock it and open the app to check services."

"1. Return to the home screen, then open recent apps with the button or gesture.
2. Find this app and use a long press, menu or downward swipe to select Lock.
3. Keep this task when clearing recent apps.

Android has no universal API for locking a task; configure it in the recent apps screen."
"Check notifications, battery optimization, background battery limits, auto-start and the recent task lock. Keep service notifications enabled and avoid force-stopping the app in system settings."

"App memory is the total PSS of the manager and managed processes under the same app user. Shared memory is counted proportionally. It includes AstrBot, NapCat and running extensions, but excludes isolated system WebView renderer processes.

Device RAM is the physical memory reported by Android, excluding storage and memory expansion. App share is the complete PSS total divided by device RAM. No percentage is shown for partial or failed measurements.

Values refresh every 15 seconds while Home is visible, and pause when you leave Home or background the app. View storage capacity in Settings → Storage usage."
